responsibility: This file implements a preprocessing GIMPLE pass specific to OpenACC kernels regions that rewrites a single 'kernels' construct into a surrounding data region plus a sequence of explicit compute constructs. It identifies top-level loop and non-loop portions of the kernels body, preserves or redistributes relevant clauses, synthesizes create/present/if/async handling, inserts cleanup via a data-region try/finally shape, and thereby converts the implicit OpenACC kernels model into forms that later OpenMP/OpenACC lowering can handle directly.
